system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes, lean and sharp-eyed, in a dressing-gown, standing still by the mantelpiece with his back half to the room","action":"Holmes gazes into the coal fire, pipe unlit in one hand, lost in thought as Watson watches him from the doorway","setting":"Baker Street sitting room at 221B, gaslit lamps low, coal fire glowing, drawn blinds with the dark street beyond","secondaryElements":"Violin resting on a chair, a scatter of papers and a photograph face-down on the table, Watson in a dark suit with one hand on the door frame, the street gaslight dim through the blinds","mood":"Restrained, reflective and intimate, with a faint undercurrent of unease about a woman who unsettles him","timeOfDay":"Night, 20 March 1888","composition":"Medium interior shot from the doorway, Holmes in the warm firelight on the left third, Watson small in the shadowed right, blinds forming dark silhouettes behind"}
